purpose: Centraliser les boutons, icônes d'action, notifications, confirmations et panneaux de logs dans un système UI homogène et réutilisable.
implemented_bricks: SVG currentColor icon expansion for navigation, media, devtools and feedback
toolbar consumption of shared button IDs
design_rules: Modules select actions by stable button ID rather than defining local button markup.
Button appearance is selected independently through a button template.
Interface icons are monochrome SVG using currentColor; emojis are not used for interface actions.
Every icon-only action exposes an accessible label or tooltip.
Semantic danger/warning/success states stay independent from the dominant theme accent.
The compact log console is a view over structured logs, never the source of truth.
Sensitive data is filtered before browser-visible logging.
